challenge.tagline: Three knocks. No one should be there.
challenge.brief: Create a horror film about a knock at the door in the dead of night. Make us feel the silence, the knock and the choice.
beats: Make us feel that something is wrong before the first knock.
What is waiting on the other side?
Open it, or don’t. Let the ending haunt us.
rules: 25–35 seconds; target 30 s including opening and end card
Made with Seedance 2.0 Fast in Cinema Studio; each generation up to 15 s
Edit and export in Wandura AI Edits with the official "Made with Wandura.ai" watermark visible throughout
Fictional characters and AI voices only; no real-person images or cloned real voices
Use media you have rights to share
Post publicly on TikTok with the AI label and #Wandura #WanduraWeekly #WanduraHorror #AIFilm
Submit the TikTok link from your registered account (18+, solo or team of up to 4, one film per week)
